reason: I like that I can try things on, and Westheimer isn't far from where I shop on Hillcroft, so I might stop in and look. But there is no Eid or wedding on my calendar in November, and I already have abayas and hijabs at home, so I would most likely walk out without buying.
objection: From a TikTok shop with young followers, I expect the styles to be either too plain or made for girls in their twenties. At my age I want good fabric and a cut that looks elegant, not trendy.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the embroidered thobes in person and finding the crepe heavy and well finished, with lengths that fit me without hemming, especially if a family wedding comes up.
